activity.notes: After Francis II died in December 1560 and the minor Charles IX succeeded, Catherine de' Medici exercised the regency. British Museum biographical data gives the regency as 1560-1563. ATLAS keeps the year-level boundaries approximate and models this as a formal governing phase.

sources.title: Catherine de' Medici, Queen and Regent of France — British Museum
sources.citation_text: The British Museum identifies Catherine as Queen of France from 1547 and Regent from 1560 to 1563, and notes her continuing political influence after the regency.

sources.title: La régence de la reine Catherine de Medicis en l'an 1560 au mois de décembre — CCFr/Bibliothèque du Sénat
sources.citation_text: The French national union catalogue preserves a Senate-library manuscript section specifically concerning Catherine de' Medici's regency beginning in December 1560.
